name: Capacity Metrics app
description: The Capacity Metrics app will features a redesigned experience with modernized visualizations, improved navigation, and enhanced analytics capabilities that make it easier to monitor, understand, and optimize Microsoft Fabric capacity usage.The updated experience provides clearer insights into utilization trends, workload consumption patterns, and performance bottlenecks, helping administrators more quickly identify capacity constraints, investigate throttling events, and make data-driven decisions to improve capacity health and efficiency.
